Members

(module scope)

Cross-platform port of install-hooks.sh — copies the versioned hooks from shared/scripts/git-hooks/ into the repo's real hooks directory AND into every initialised submodule's hooks dir. The same hook files serve both contexts: they detect --show-superproject-working-tree and gate only their own module when invoked inside one.

Uses git rev-parse --git-dir so worktrees and submodule checkouts resolve their true hooks dir (a .git file, not a directory).

Run once after cloning (or after pulling when hooks change): yarn hooks:install

installInto

Copies every versioned hook into one repo's real hooks directory.
